children: Malaysia's auto sales in November could be sequentially stronger, driven by more aggressive year-end discounting and festive promotions, Affin Hwang IB analyst Afifah Ishak says in a note. Automakers are expected to step up efforts to boost deliveries ahead of the year-end, she says. The analyst maintains her 2026 Malaysia auto sales estimate at 815,000 units, down 1% from a year earlier. Affin Hwang maintains a neutral rating on the Malaysian auto and auto-parts sector, pegging MBM Resources as its top pick, citing its resilient earnings profile, underpinned by its associate stake in national carmaker Perodua. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
